title: useURLLocation
summary: Read the visible URL together with navigation state and its history key.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Takes no arguments and requires RouterProvider. Browser history state is maintained by the application navigation integration.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns a memoized URL with additional state and key properties. Standard URL properties such as pathname, search, hash, origin, and href remain available. The key identifies the current application history entry.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: Use this value for display and derived state. Navigate through Link, useNavigate, or the router rather than mutating this URL object.

sections.title: Visible versus pending
sections.body: With retained views, this URL follows the committed snapshot while the next route loads. useNavigation().location reports a pending destination when the integration exposes one. A bare router does not independently maintain navigation history keys and state.
